brief: First brief of a NEW domain. The clock tower's vane (drawClockTower, ~line 3897) is a static triangle drawn at `vane = project(..., top + 4.8)`; it points the same way in a west gale as an east one. Make it a weathervane: its arrow turns to a heading driven by windSign·windF() — pointing INTO the wind (the way vanes do), swinging through the blend windDir() so a latch never steps a frame, with a little calm-drift wobble folded from a hash the tower already has, not a new R(). Add the same vane to the church tower (CHURCH tx0..tx1) so two vanes agree across the whole width of the town; the chimney smoke (drawSmoke) already leans windDir() — after this the smoke, the vanes, the rain slant and the bunting all say the same wind. If the tower is CACHED (check drawBlocks/facades), the vane must become a live overlay drawn after the cache, projected per frame — the rose window (#81, roseLit) is the model.
successLooksLike: probes/vane.mjs: force windSign +1 and −1 on a windy day and read the arrow's projected tip x on each; under calm (windF 0) the arrow sits within a few degrees of its rest heading; at windF 1 the two signs give mirror headings. Crops of the tower at the two signs in shots/. Wide-view hash IDENTICAL to HEAD when windF is forced 0 and the wobble hash is forced to its rest value.
avoid: No new R() draw. Do not turn the vane in the CACHE (a cached vane steps at the bucket cadence — the rose window's old seam). Do not make the smoke read anything new — it is already right.
